fit_linear_references: fit linear element references for target properties using a dataset and least squares regression
create_element_references: create a LinearReferences module from a .pt or .npz file or state dictionary
apply_refs: subtract element reference values from a tensor using the ElementReferences apply_refs method
dereference_targets: remove linear references from target tensors using the LinearReferences dereference method
load_references_from_config: load element references from a config dictionary using load_references_from_config with a dataset
